_how_to_use: Copy this file to config.json, fill in what you have, then run:  venv\Scripts\python.exe -m jarvis_addons.config_file --apply   (config.json is git-ignored; the values go into the local database jarvis_memory.db, which is git-ignored too). Leave a placeholder as it is to skip that entry. The interactive alternative is:  venv\Scripts\python.exe jarvis_setup.py

_notes.AI keys: At least one of gemini_api_key (aistudio.google.com) or groq_keys (console.groq.com, several keys separated by commas) - or a local Ollama model, which needs no key.
_notes.telegram: Optional. Easier:  python -m jarvis_addons.telegram_bot --setup  (it learns your user id by itself).
_notes.phone: Optional. Easier:  python -m jarvis_addons.phone_link  (finds the phone on your Wi-Fi, no address to type).
_notes.dry_run: 1 = WhatsApp messages are typed but NOT sent (safe default). 0 = really sent.
_notes.environment variables: GEMINI_API_KEY and JARVIS_PHONE_PASSWORD are read when the entry above is not set; PEXELS_API_KEY (optional) is used by the website builder for stock photos.
_notes.dashboard password: Not set here: the first start writes a random one to dashboard_password.txt, or run  python -m jarvis_addons.dashboard --set-password ...
